# Model URL reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generateModelUrlsDoc.js from src/utils/modelRegistry.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Where `ml5 cache prefetch` downloads each model from, and the folder inside `ml5-models/<model>/` it is saved to.

For a beginner-friendly walkthrough with manual download instructions, see [`manual-model-setup/where-to-download-models.md`](./manual-model-setup/where-to-download-models.md).

TensorFlow.js sources are folders: append `/model.json` to download the model file, then download each weight file it lists from the same folder. For `tfhub.dev` and `kaggle.com` sources, also add `?tfjs-format=file` to the end of every file URL.

A source that ends in `.json` is the model file itself. Save it as `model.json`; its weight files are in the same remote folder.

## HandPose (`handpose`)

### TensorFlow.js

| Variant | Part | Local folder | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `full` (default) | detector | `tfjs/detector/` | https://tfhub.dev/mediapipe/tfjs-model/handpose_3d/detector/full/1 |
| `full` (default) | landmark | `tfjs/landmark/` | https://tfhub.dev/mediapipe/tfjs-model/handpose_3d/landmark/full/1 |
| `lite` | detector | `tfjs/detector-lite/` | https://tfhub.dev/mediapipe/tfjs-model/handpose_3d/detector/lite/1 |
| `lite` | landmark | `tfjs/landmark-lite/` | https://tfhub.dev/mediapipe/tfjs-model/handpose_3d/landmark/lite/1 |

### MediaPipe

Package `@mediapipe/hands@0.4.1675469240`. Files are saved to `mediapipe/` and are available at `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/hands@0.4.1675469240/<file>`.

Every variant needs:

- `hands.binarypb`
- `hands.js`
- `hands_solution_packed_assets.data`
- `hands_solution_packed_assets_loader.js`
- `hands_solution_simd_wasm_bin.js`
- `hands_solution_simd_wasm_bin.wasm`
- `hands_solution_simd_wasm_bin.data`
- `hands_solution_wasm_bin.js`
- `hands_solution_wasm_bin.wasm`

Plus one file per variant:

- `full`: `hand_landmark_full.tflite`
- `lite`: `hand_landmark_lite.tflite`
